record.bible_text: Now the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto Jonah<WH03124> the son<WH01121> of Amittai<WH0573>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, <RF>Jonah: Gr. Jonas<Rf>

So the shipmaster<WH07227><WH02259> came<WH07126><WTH8799> to him, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper<WH07290><WTH8737>? arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, call<WH07121><WTH8798> upon thy God<WH0430>, if so be that God<WH0430> will think<WH06245><WTH8691> upon us, that we perish<WH06><WTH8799> not.

So they cast<WH05307><WTH8686> lots<WH01486>, and the lot<WH01486> fell<WH05307><WTH8799> upon Jonah<WH03124>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> they unto him, Tell<WH05046><WTH8685> us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil<WH07451> <FI>is<Fi> upon us; What <FI>is<Fi> thine occupation<WH04399>? and whence<WH0370> comest<WH0935><WTH8799> thou? what <FI>is<Fi>  thy country<WH0776>? and of what people<WH05971> <FI>art<Fi> thou?

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, I <FI>am<Fi> an Hebrew<WH05680>; and I fear<WH03373> the LORD<WH03068>, the God<WH0430> of heaven<WH08064>, which hath made<WH06213><WTH8804> the sea<WH03220> and the dry<WH03004> <FI>land<Fi> . <RF>the LORD: or, JEHOVAH<Rf>

Then were the men<WH0582> exceedingly<WH01419><WH03374> afraid<WH03372><WTH8799>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Why hast thou done<WH06213><WTH8804> this?
